# SM Techno Service

> Hyderabad's #1 washing machine repair and service center. Same-day doorstep repair, installation, uninstallation, deep cleaning, water drainage and PCB repair for all major brands including LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, Bosch and IFB. 90-day warranty on all repairs and genuine spare parts.

SM Techno Service is a washing machine repair and service center serving all areas of Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We provide professional repair and maintenance for all washing machine brands with same-day service, 90-day warranty, genuine parts and no hidden charges.

## Services

- Washing Machine Repair: Motor repair, pump replacement, drum repair and electrical problems
- Installation: Professional setup of new washing machines with water connection setup, machine leveling and test run
- Uninstallation: Safe removal of old or damaged washing machines
- Deep Cleaning: Complete internal cleaning and sanitization to remove dirt, bacteria and bad odors
- Water Drainage: Fix drainage problems, blocked pipes and water leakage
- PCB Repair: Electronic control board and display panel repair

## Types of Machines Serviced

- Fully-Automatic Front-Load
- Fully-Automatic Top-Load
- Semi-Automatic Top-Load
- Compact/Portable

## Brands We Service

LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, Bosch, IFB, Haier, Panasonic, Godrej, Videocon, Onida
